title: 第89章 以战证道越打越强第88章 深夜相见互诉疑虑
slug: 朽道归墟我以残灵证长生
lines: 后山断崖的深夜密谈散去，月色西斜，浓重的雾气自谷底升腾，将整片荒坟山林裹上一层朦胧冷白。
林寂辞别苏清砚，借着夜色掩护，循着早已熟记于心的监视盲区折返小院，周身朽道之力层层内敛，把自身气息压缩至微尘级别，四道潜伏密林的暗卫只捕捉到一阵转瞬即逝的夜风，丝毫未曾察觉目标早已外出密会、洞悉全盘杀局。
踏入院内青石地坪，林寂抬手撤去周身虚化遮掩，盘膝坐回蒲团之上。方才与苏清砚互通所有隐秘、理清宗门千年阴谋的思绪尚未平复，心底却生出一层清晰的顿悟——他手中唯一能够抗衡整座伪道体系、撕碎天道收割棋局的依仗，从来不是口舌辩词，而是朽道本源蕴藏的逆伐之力。

此前数次交手，从初次碾压挑衅外门弟子，到擂台一战击溃江辰，每一次激烈对战结束后，他都能隐约捕捉到战场残留的细碎灰色纹路，彼时只当是对战碰撞逸散的朽气余波，并未深究其中蕴藏的大道玄机。可今夜看透高层全盘算计、知晓决赛擂台将是生死对决后，他沉下心神，催动朽道真眼向内自省，终于捕捉到潜藏在厮杀之中的修行捷径。天地间一切正统灵力碰撞、道纹对冲，都会撕裂表层天道规则，滋生出大量腐朽道痕。这些道痕是灵气被反复催动、磨损、侵蚀后诞生的法则残渣，也是天道藏在正统功法里的本源朽毒载体。
寻常修士只会被这类道痕悄然寄生、日积月累侵蚀道基，唯有修持朽道的他，能够反向吞噬、熔炼提纯，将海量战场腐朽道痕转化为自身逆道本源，实现真正的以战养道、愈战愈强。
这是独属于朽道的无上天赋，是天道万万没有预料到的破绽——天道以朽毒束缚众生，却造就了能够吞噬朽毒、挣脱掌控的逆道传人。

林寂心神沉入丹田，缓缓复盘过往每一场对战残留的道痕变化。初入宗门时与外门弟子切磋，战场逸散的腐朽道痕稀薄细碎，吸收之后仅能小幅稳固肉身经脉；后山与数名内门核心弟子冲突，大量凝气境正统灵力碰撞催生成片朽纹，尽数吸纳后，他的朽道运转速度直接提升三成；而擂台之上对战金丹初期江辰，那场巅峰对决碰撞出的腐朽道痕最为浓郁厚重，江辰一身圆满道基蕴含的深层朽毒，在对战破碎后化作漫天细密道纹，大半被他当场吞纳，才让他的本源底蕴一举突破归墟境桎梏，触摸到半步金丹的门槛。只是此前他始终被动吸收，对战结束才会被动接纳逸散道痕，效率低下，浪费大半厮杀诞生的法则残渣。如今洞悉完整机制，他决意主动引动战场腐朽道痕，以厮杀为熔炉，以道痕为薪柴，借对战打磨自身逆道根基，在决赛来临之前，将朽道战力推至顶峰。
心念既定，林寂不再固守小院闭门静坐，决定主动寻一场对战，实地印证吞噬道痕、以战证道的蜕变之法。他算准暗卫轮换间隙，趁着两道值守暗卫神念同步扫向西侧坟区的刹那，身形虚化掠出小院，直奔后山外围一处弟子私斗频发的乱石山谷。此处常年有内门弟子因资源、名次争执交手，灵力碰撞从未断绝，地面岩壁常年沉积厚厚的腐朽道痕，是天然的道痕熔炉。

远远便听见激烈的灵力碰撞轰鸣，两道白灵光晕在乱石之间来回冲撞，两名筑基圆满的内门弟子各执灵刃，运转《清玄御灵诀》全力厮杀，招式凌厉，灵气对冲不断炸出细碎灰雾。那层灰雾，正是正统灵力碰撞撕裂规则诞生的腐朽道痕凝聚而成。二人厮杀正酣，谁也未曾察觉暗处隐匿的清瘦身影。林寂立于崖边暗影之中，朽道真眼全开，视野之下整片山谷布满纵横交错的暗灰色纹路，岩壁、地面、空气之中，密密麻麻漂浮着数万道细碎腐朽道痕，随着二人每一次兵器交击、灵力对冲，持续源源不断新生、蔓延、飘散。寻常修士踏入此地，不出半个时辰，体内淤积的朽毒便会暴涨一截，道基隐患大幅加深，可对林寂而言，这片山谷如同遍地至宝的修行秘境。

不再观望，林寂脚步轻踏，身形无声落入乱石战场中央。两道激战的弟子骤然察觉外人闯入，猛地收招后撤，神色警惕又带着几分愠怒。“后山禁地边缘，何人擅自闯入，打扰我等切磋？”左侧持长剑的弟子眉头紧锁，周身正统灵气依旧剧烈翻涌，道基表层的朽纹清晰可见，“若是寻常闲散弟子，速速退去，莫要挡我二人分胜负！”另一人紧随其后，灵盾横在身前，上下打量林寂，看清那张传遍全宗的面孔后，眼底瞬间涌上忌惮与鄙夷：“是林寂？传闻你修持诡异邪道，今日来此，莫非是想插手我等正统弟子比试，再散播那些歪理谬论？”二人早已听闻修行坪上林寂规劝众人提防功法朽毒的传言，心底根深蒂固认定他是惑乱道心的邪修，言语间满是抵触，周身灵气不自觉运转至巅峰，隐隐摆出联手戒备的姿态。

林寂神色平淡，无半分争辩之意，只是淡淡开口：“无需顾忌，全力出手。今日我只借你二人正统灵力碰撞，淬炼自身道途。”话音未落，两名内门弟子只当他狂妄自大、轻视自身修为，怒火瞬间翻涌。二人对视一眼，默契同步催动功法，一白一青两道灵气洪流交织席卷，灵剑、灵盾同时朝着林寂轰击而来，正统道纹层层叠叠，裹挟着宗门正统功法的磅礴威势。“既然你自寻难堪，那便别怪我等出手教训邪修！”剑光撕裂空气，灵盾碾压地面，两股纯粹的正统灵力轰然撞向林寂身躯。

若是寻常归墟境修士直面双重筑基圆满攻势，只能仓促运转灵力防御，可林寂不闪不避，周身缓缓升腾起一层稀薄灰色朽气屏障。两股正统灵力重重撞在朽气屏障之上，轰然炸开巨大灵气冲击波，轰鸣震得整片乱石山谷震颤不止。正统白、青色灵气与灰色朽气剧烈对冲、相互撕扯，天道规则与逆道法则激烈碰撞，无数细碎裂纹在空气之中浮现，每一道裂纹都快速凝结出暗灰色腐朽道痕，如同漫天飞絮般四散漂浮。就在道痕诞生的刹那，林寂体内朽道本源自行运转，形成一股无形的吸纳漩涡。漫天纷飞的腐朽道痕如同归巢蜂群，不再四处飘散，尽数调转方向，顺着周身朽气脉络，源源不断涌入他的四肢百骸、经脉丹田。每一道道痕入体，都先被丹田内的朽道熔炉拆解、提纯，剔除其中残留的正统天道枷锁，只留下纯粹的逆道本源能量，滋养肉身、重塑道基纹路。清晰的蜕变感顺着经脉蔓延全身，骨骼发出细微绵长的嗡鸣，肉身表层原本浅淡的朽纹脉络不断拓宽、加深，丹田内的朽道本源愈发厚重凝练，原本卡在归墟境巅峰许久的壁垒，开始出现松动裂痕。

对面两名内门弟子见攻势被轻松拦下，心头一惊，不敢停歇，再度联手猛攻，灵剑连环斩击、灵盾震荡冲击波层层叠叠，连绵不绝的正统灵力冲击持续不断。每一次碰撞，都会催生更多、更浓郁的腐朽道痕，源源不断供给林寂吞噬炼化。“怎么回事？我的灵力打在他身上，逸散的灵气灰雾全都朝着他身上飘去！”持剑弟子越打越是心惊，清晰察觉到自身灵力损耗速度远超往日，本该消散在空气里的灵力残渣，仿佛被无形吸力强行抽走，“此人邪术诡异，能吞吸我等正统灵力残留，不可久战！”二人心中惊惧，攻势却愈发狂暴，想要尽快击溃眼前之人，可他们的猛攻，恰恰是在源源不断为林寂输送淬炼道基的养料。

林寂周身朽气流转愈发磅礴，吸纳道痕的速度不断加快，整片山谷漂浮的数万道腐朽道痕，短短数息便被吞噬大半，岩壁地面沉积的陈年老旧道痕，也顺着泥土纹路向上攀升，汇入他的身躯。海量腐朽道痕熔炼转化，带来实打实的战力蜕变。肉身强度稳步攀升，经脉容纳本源的上限大幅拓宽，神魂感知范围扩张数倍，朽道之力的腐蚀、拆解、溯源三重神通同步得到强化。此前只能远距离微弱溯源神念，如今只需一丝朽气附着，便能穿透数层阵法屏障窥探内里动静；此前只能缓慢消解表层朽毒，如今可一瞬间瓦解筑基修士体内大半寄生纹路。

激战持续百息，两名内门弟子灵力消耗过半，面色苍白、气息紊乱，周身正统灵气已然黯淡无光，再难打出完整攻势。反观林寂，周身灰色朽气愈发浓郁厚重，身形挺拔如山，气息沉稳磅礴，丝毫不见疲惫，反而周身散发出的压迫感持续攀升，隐隐已经超出归墟境该有的层次。最后一记双灵合击轰至，林寂抬手轻挥，一缕凝练至极的朽气正面撞上两道灵气洪流，瞬间将对方灵力撕裂瓦解，衍生出最后一大片浓郁腐朽道痕，尽数吞入丹田熔炉彻底炼化。两名弟子灵力一空，瘫坐在乱石之上，满脸骇然地望着林寂，再也生不出半分对抗之心。他们亲眼见证，自己全力厮杀诞生的所有灵力残渣、腐朽道痕，尽数被对方吸收转化，对方非但没有损耗，反而愈发强盛，这般诡异的能力，彻底颠覆了他们对修行的全部认知。林寂无意为难二人，道痕吸纳完毕，周身朽气缓缓收敛，淡淡留下一句告诫，便转身离去：“你二人功法藏毒，厮杀催生的腐朽道痕会持续侵蚀道基，长此以往，境界越高，陨落越快。”说完，身形消失在山谷雾气之中，只留下两名呆坐原地、满心惊疑的内门弟子。

折返后山小院途中，林寂持续梳理体内暴涨的本源力量，心底对“以战证道”的机制有了完整透彻的认知。正统修士交战，本质是互相催生朽毒、加速自身腐朽，唯独朽道修士，能将这场厮杀的负面法则残渣化为自身晋升资粮，厮杀越是激烈、对手修为越高，碰撞诞生的腐朽道痕便越是厚重，吸收转化后的战力提升也就越是恐怖。江辰身为金丹初期天骄，一身圆满道基蕴藏的朽毒远超寻常修士，决赛擂台之上，二人全力对战碰撞，必然会滋生整片天地级别的海量腐朽道痕。届时万众瞩目之下，他既能借对战吞噬海量道痕，将自身战力彻底推至半步金丹巅峰，又能当众引爆江辰体内淤积的朽毒，让全宗弟子亲眼见证正统功法的致命缺陷，一举两得，完美达成破局目标。

回到小院，林寂盘膝落座，不再刻意伪装平缓的正统灵气流转，任由体内熔炼完毕的海量道痕本源自由游走周身。肉眼可见的细密灰色纹路在皮肤之下缓缓流转，原本单薄的朽道基盘不断拓宽增厚，丹田深处凝聚出一枚近乎实体的灰色朽道种子，散发出逆伐天道的凛冽气息。他抬手轻抬，一缕朽气外放，瞬间穿透小院围墙，延伸至外围密林，清晰捕捉到四名暗卫全部的站位、神念波动，甚至能透过他们的神魂羁绊，模糊感知到主峰凌霄大殿三位长老此刻商议的细碎念头。海量战场道痕熔炼带来的神魂增幅，让他的反向探查能力再度跃升，高层任何一点风吹草动，都再也无法瞒过他的感知。
院外密林之中，轮换值守的暗卫只察觉到院内一丝短暂的灰色气流一闪而逝，只当是山间阴风吹过，并未放在心上，依旧老老实实记录小院“平静无异常”的情报，连夜传往主峰大殿。他们永远不会知晓，方才那场不起眼的内门弟子切磋，已经让林寂的本源底蕴、综合战力完成一次巨大跃迁，距离抗衡三名金丹长老的目标，又近了一大步。夜色将尽，天边泛起一缕微弱鱼肚白，后山荒坟之间冷风渐歇。
林寂缓缓收束周身朽道本源，心神沉静如水，眼底战意滚烫凛冽。修行无需闭门枯坐，厮杀便是最佳熔炉；证道不必空谈法理，腐朽道痕皆为阶梯。
高层布下决赛杀局，欲借万众之口定他邪修罪名、镇杀朽道传人；可他们万万想不到，这场万众瞩目的擂台之战，于林寂而言，是一场前所未有的大道淬炼，是海量腐朽道痕汇聚的无上修行机缘。
愈战，道愈深；愈杀，力愈强。待到决赛擂台之上，他将以江辰的圆满正统道基为薪，以万众见证的厮杀为炉，吞噬漫天腐朽道痕，以战证道，逆伐万古伪局，撕碎青玄宗代代隐瞒的天道骗局。
小院之中，逆道之力静静蛰伏，只待擂台开启，一战破万法，一战昭万古真相。
content_en:
The late-night secret talks on the cliffs at the back of the mountain had dispersed, the moon was setting in the west, and thick mist rose from the bottom of the valley, covering the entire barren mountain forest with a layer of hazy and cold white.
Lin Ji said goodbye to Su Qingyan, and under the cover of darkness, she returned to the small courtyard following the surveillance blind spot that she had long known by heart. She restrained her body's power layer by layer, compressing her aura to the level of dust. The four secret guards lurking in the dense forest only caught a fleeting night breeze, and did not realize that the target had already gone out for a secret meeting to gain insight into the overall killing situation.
Stepping onto the bluestone floor in the courtyard, Lin Ji raised her hand to remove the blurred cover around her body, and sat back on the futon cross-legged. The thought of exchanging all the secrets with Su Qingyan and sorting out the millennium conspiracy of the sect has not yet calmed down, but there is a clear epiphany in his heart - the only thing in his hand that can compete with the entire pseudo-dao system and tear apart the heavenly Dao harvest chess game is never verbal arguments, but the counterattack power contained in the origin of the rotten Dao.
He had fought several times before, from the first time he crushed and provoked the outer sect disciples to defeating Jiang Chen in the ring. After each fierce battle, he could vaguely capture the fine gray lines left on the battlefield. At that time, he only regarded it as the aftermath of the collision of the battle, and did not delve into the great mystery contained in it. But tonight, after seeing through the entire plan of the top management and knowing that the final stage would be a life-and-death showdown, he calmed down his mind, activated the True Eyes of Decay to introspect, and finally captured the shortcut to practice hidden in the fighting. All orthodox spiritual power collisions and Dao pattern clashes between heaven and earth will tear apart the superficial Heavenly Dao rules and breed a large number of corrupt Dao marks. These Dao Marks are the residue of the law that is born after the spiritual energy has been repeatedly stimulated, worn out, and eroded. They are also the carriers of the original rotten poison of the Heavenly Dao hidden in the orthodox exercises.
Ordinary monks will only be quietly parasitized by such Dao marks and erode the Dao foundation over time. Only he who practices the rotten Dao can reversely devour, smelt and purify, and transform the massive decayed Dao marks on the battlefield into his own inverse Dao origin, so as to truly nourish the Dao with war and become stronger with each battle.
This is the supreme talent that belongs only to the rotten dao, and it is a flaw that the heavenly dao never expected - the heavenly dao binds all living beings with the rotten poison, but it creates a successor to the evil path who can swallow the rotten poison and break free from its control.
Lin Ji's mind sank into his dantian, slowly reviewing the changes in the Dao marks remaining in each battle in the past. When he first entered the sect, he sparred with the outer sect disciples. The decayed Dao marks that escaped from the battlefield were thin and fine, and after being absorbed, they could only slightly stabilize the meridians of the physical body; Houshan clashed with several inner sect core disciples, and the collision of a large amount of Qi Condensation Realm orthodox spiritual power generated a piece of decayed marks. After absorbing all of them, his rotten path running speed increased by 30%; and in the arena, When he fought against Jiang Chen in the early stage of the Golden Elixir, the decaying dao marks that were collided in that peak duel were the thickest and thickest. The deep decaying poison contained in Jiang Chen's perfect dao foundation turned into fine dao marks all over the sky after the battle. Most of them were swallowed by him on the spot, which allowed his original foundation to break through the shackles of the Return to Ruins Realm in one fell swoop and touch the threshold of the half-step golden elixir. It's just that he had always passively absorbed it before, and would only passively accept the escaped traces after the battle. It was inefficient and wasted most of the residue of the laws born from the fighting. Now that he understands the complete mechanism, he is determined to actively activate the rotten path marks on the battlefield, use fighting as a furnace, use the dao marks as firewood, and use battles to polish his anti-path foundation, and push the rotten path combat power to its peak before the finals come.
With her mind set, Lin Ji no longer sat quietly in the small courtyard behind closed doors, and decided to take the initiative to find a battle to prove the transformation method of swallowing Dao marks and proving Dao through battle. He calculated the interval between the rotations of the secret guards, and took advantage of the moment when the two secret guards' spiritual thoughts were synchronously sweeping toward the west side of the tomb area. He turned into a blur and swept out of the small courtyard, heading straight for a rocky valley on the outskirts of the back mountain where private fights among disciples frequently occurred. Disciples from the inner sect have been fighting here all year round due to disputes over resources and rankings. The collision of spiritual powers has never stopped. Thick decaying Dao marks have been deposited on the rock walls all year round. It is a natural furnace of Dao marks.
From a distance, one can hear the fierce collision and roar of spiritual energy. Two white spirit haloes collided back and forth among the rocks. Two inner disciples who had completed their foundation construction each held spiritual blades and used the "Qing Xuan Yuling Jue" to fight with all their strength. Their moves were fierce, and the spiritual energy counterattack continued to blast out fine gray mist. That layer of gray mist is the condensed form of decayed traces born from the collision and tearing rules of orthodox spiritual power. The two were fighting in full swing, and no one noticed the thin figure hiding in the darkness. Lin Ji stood in the shadow of the cliff, with his true eyes of the rotten path fully open. The entire valley under his field of vision was covered with criss-crossing dark gray lines. There were tens of thousands of tiny traces of the rotten path floating densely on the rock walls, the ground, and the air. With every clash of weapons and spiritual power between the two, they continued to regenerate, spread, and drift away. When an ordinary monk steps into this place, within half an hour, the rotten poison accumulated in the body will skyrocket, and the hidden dangers of the Taoist foundation will be greatly deepened. But to Lin Ji, this valley is like a secret cultivation realm full of treasures.
No longer watching, Lin Ji stepped lightly and silently fell into the center of the rocky battlefield. The two disciples who were fighting fiercely suddenly noticed the intrusion of an outsider and retreated suddenly, their expressions vigilant and a bit sullen. "Who is trespassing on the edge of the forbidden area of ​​the back mountain and interrupting our discussion?" The disciple holding the long sword on the left frowned, the orthodox spiritual energy around his body was still surging violently, and the decayed patterns on the surface of the Taoist foundation were clearly visible, "If you are an ordinary idle disciple, retreat quickly and don't stop us from deciding the outcome!" The other person followed closely, holding a spiritual shield in front of him. He looked Lin Ji up and down. After seeing the face that was known throughout the sect, his eyes instantly filled with tears. Fear and contempt: "Is it Lin Ji? It is rumored that you practice a weird and evil way. Are you here today to intervene in the competition between us and other orthodox disciples and spread those fallacies?" The two of them had already heard about Lin Ji on the training ground. He advised everyone to be wary of the rumors about the rottenness of the martial arts. Deep down in his heart, he believed that he was an evil cultivator who confused the Taoist mind. His words were filled with contradictions. The aura around his body unconsciously reached its peak, and he faintly assumed a posture of joint vigilance.
Lin Ji's expression was calm, with no intention of arguing, and he just said calmly: "No need to worry, just attack with all your strength. Today I will only use the collision of your two orthodox spiritual powers to temper your own path." Before he finished speaking, the two inner disciples thought that he was arrogant and despised his own cultivation, and their anger instantly surged. The two of them looked at each other, tacitly activating the skills simultaneously. Two torrents of spiritual energy, one white and one green, intertwined and swept across. The spiritual sword and spiritual shield simultaneously bombarded Lin Ji. The orthodox Dao patterns were layered on top of each other, carrying the majestic power of the sect's orthodox techniques. "Since you are looking for embarrassment, don't blame me for teaching the evil cultivators a lesson!" The sword light tore through the air, the spiritual shield crushed the ground, and two pure orthodox spiritual powers crashed into Lin Ji's body.
If an ordinary Guixu Realm cultivator were to face the double foundation-building perfect offensive, they could only rush to activate their spiritual defense, but Lin Ji did not dodge, and a thin gray barrier of decayed energy slowly rose up around his body. The two orthodox spiritual powers collided heavily with the decaying energy barrier, exploding a huge spiritual energy shock wave, and the roar shook the entire rocky valley. The orthodox white and cyan spiritual energy and the gray decayed energy violently conflicted and tore at each other. The laws of heaven and the laws of the reversed path collided fiercely. Countless fine cracks emerged in the air. Each crack quickly condensed into dark gray traces of decay, which were scattered and floating like catkins all over the sky. At the moment when the Dao Hen was born, the origin of the rotten Dao in Lin Ji's body circulated on its own, forming an invisible vortex of absorption. The decaying traces flying all over the sky were like swarms of returning bees. They no longer scattered in all directions. They all turned around and flowed into his limbs, meridians and Dantian along the veins of decaying energy all over his body. Every mark of the Dao that enters the body is first dismantled and purified by the furnace of the rotten Dao in the Dantian, removing the remaining orthodox shackles of the Dao, leaving only the pure original energy of the reverse Dao to nourish the body and reshape the Dao foundation lines. A clear sense of transformation spreads throughout the body along the meridians, and the bones emit a subtle and long-lasting hum. The originally light veins of decay lines on the surface of the body continue to widen and deepen. The origin of the decay path in the Dantian becomes thicker and more concise. The barriers that had been stuck at the peak of the Return to Ruins Realm for a long time began to loosen and crack.
The two inner disciples on the opposite side were frightened when they saw that the attack was easily stopped. They did not dare to stop, and they joined forces to attack again. The spiritual swords slashed continuously, the spiritual shields vibrated and shock waves were layered, and the continuous orthodox spiritual power impact continued. Every collision would produce more and richer traces of decay, which would be continuously supplied to Lin Ji for devouring and refining. "What's going on? My spiritual power hit him, and all the gray mist of spiritual energy drifted towards him!" The sword-wielding disciple became more and more frightened as he hit him. He clearly realized that his spiritual power was being depleted much faster than before. The residual spiritual power that should have been dissipated in the air seemed to be sucked by an invisible force. He was forcefully removed, "This person has weird magic and can absorb the remnants of our orthodox spiritual power. We cannot fight for a long time!" The two of them were frightened, but their offensive became more and more violent. They wanted to defeat the person in front of them as soon as possible, but their fierce attacks were just supplying Lin Ji with a steady stream of nourishment for tempering his Dao foundation.
The flow of rotten air around Lin Ji became more and more majestic, and the speed of absorbing Dao marks continued to accelerate. Most of the tens of thousands of rotten Dao marks floating in the entire valley were swallowed up in just a few breaths. The old Dao marks deposited on the rock wall and ground also climbed up along the soil lines and merged into his body. Massive amounts of decayed traces are smelted and transformed, bringing about a real transformation of combat power. The strength of the physical body has steadily increased, the upper limit of the meridians' ability to accommodate the source has been greatly expanded, the range of the soul's perception has been expanded several times, and the three magical powers of corrosion, dismantling, and traceability of the power of decay have been simultaneously strengthened. Previously, spiritual thoughts could only be traced weakly from a distance, but now, with just a trace of rotten energy attached, they can penetrate several layers of formation barriers to peer into what's going on inside; before, they could only slowly dispel the surface rotten poison, but now they can disintegrate most of the parasitic patterns in the body of the foundation-building monks in an instant.
The fierce battle continued for hundreds of breaths, and the two inner disciples' spiritual energy was consumed by more than half. Their faces were pale, their auras were disordered, and the orthodox spiritual energy around them was dimmed, making it difficult to launch a complete offensive. Looking back at Lin Ji, the gray rotten air around him became thicker and thicker. His figure was as tall as a mountain, his aura was calm and majestic, and he did not feel tired at all. On the contrary, the sense of oppression emanating from his body continued to rise, and it was faintly beyond the level that should be expected in the Return to Ruins Realm. When the last two-spirit strike came, Lin Ji raised his hand and waved lightly. A ray of extremely condensed rotten energy collided head-on with two torrents of spiritual energy, instantly tearing apart the opponent's spiritual energy and disintegrating it, creating the last large piece of rich rotten traces, all of which were swallowed into the dantian furnace for complete refining. The two disciples had lost all their spiritual energy and sat slumped on the rocks. They looked at Lin Ji with horrified faces, unable to show any intention of confrontation. They witnessed with their own eyes that all the spiritual energy residues and decayed traces created by their own efforts were absorbed and transformed by the opponent. Instead of being wasted, the opponent became stronger and stronger. Such a strange ability completely subverted their entire understanding of practice. Lin Ji had no intention of embarrassing the two of them. After absorbing the Dao Marks, the rotten energy around him slowly converged. He left a faint warning before turning around and leaving: "The two of you have hidden poisons in their martial arts. The rotten Dao Marks generated by the fighting will continue to erode the Dao foundation. If things go on like this, the higher the realm, the faster the fall." After saying that, his figure disappeared into the mist of the valley, leaving only two inner disciples sitting there, full of surprise.
On the way back to the small courtyard in the back mountain, Lin Ji continued to sort out the surge of original power in his body, and had a complete and thorough understanding of the mechanism of "proving the Tao through battle" in his heart. The essence of the battle between orthodox monks is to promote each other's rotten poison and accelerate their own decay. Only the rotten monks can turn the negative law residue of this fight into their own promotion qualifications. The more intense the fight, the higher the opponent's cultivation level, the thicker the traces of decay created by the collision, and the more terrifying the increase in combat power after absorption and transformation. Jiang Chen is a genius in the early stage of the golden elixir, and the rotten poison contained in his perfect Dao foundation is far beyond that of ordinary monks. On the final stage, the two of them will fight and collide with each other, which will inevitably breed a massive amount of rotten Dao marks on the level of the entire world. At that time, under the spotlight of everyone, he could not only use the battle to devour massive Dao Marks, completely pushing his own combat power to the peak of half-step Jindan, but also detonate the rotten poison accumulated in Jiang Chen's body in public, allowing all the disciples of the sect to witness the fatal flaw of the orthodox martial arts, killing two birds with one stone, and perfectly achieving the goal of breaking the game.
Returning to the small courtyard, Lin Ji sat down cross-legged, no longer deliberately pretending to have a gentle flow of orthodox spiritual energy, and allowed the massive amount of Dao marks that had been smelted in the body to freely roam around her body. Fine gray lines visible to the naked eye slowly flowed under the skin. The originally thin base of the rotten path continued to widen and thicken, and an almost solid gray rotten path seed condensed deep in the dantian, exuding a cold aura of fighting against the heavenly way. He raised his hand lightly, and a wisp of rotten energy was released. It instantly penetrated the wall of the small courtyard and extended to the outer dense forest. He clearly captured all the positions and fluctuations of the spiritual thoughts of the four secret guards. He could even vaguely perceive the detailed thoughts of the three elders of the main peak Lingxiao Hall discussing at this moment through their spiritual bonds. The increase in soul brought by the smelting of massive battlefield traces has made his reverse detection ability jump again. Any slightest disturbance in the high-level can no longer be hidden from his perception.
In the dense forest outside the courtyard, the secret guards on duty only noticed a brief flash of gray air in the courtyard. They thought it was a dark wind blowing from the mountains and did not take it to heart. They still honestly recorded the "calm and normal" information of the small courtyard and sent it to the main peak hall overnight. They would never know that the inconspicuous competition between the inner disciples just now had already made Lin Ji's original foundation and comprehensive combat power complete a huge leap, and he was a big step closer to the goal of competing against the three Jindan elders. As the night draws to an end, a faint wisp of fish belly white appears on the horizon, and the cold wind gradually subsides among the barren tombs in the back mountains.
Lin Ji slowly restrained his body's rotten energy, his mind was as calm as water, and the fighting spirit in his eyes was hot and cold. There is no need to sit behind closed doors to practice, fighting is the best melting pot; there is no need to talk about Dharma principles to achieve enlightenment, the decayed traces of the path are all steps.
The top management arranged the finals, hoping to use the public's opinions to accuse him of evil cultivating and to suppress the successors of the rotten Tao. However, they never imagined that this highly anticipated battle in the arena was, for Lin Ji, an unprecedented training of the Tao, and a supreme opportunity for cultivation where a large number of traces of the rotten Tao gathered together.
The more you fight, the deeper your path becomes; the more you kill, the stronger your power becomes. When he reaches the final stage, he will use Jiang Chen's perfect and orthodox Dao foundation as his salary, the fight witnessed by thousands of people as his furnace, swallow up the decaying Dao marks all over the sky, prove his Dao through battle, fight against the eternal false trap, and tear apart the Heavenly Dao scam that Qingxuan Sect has concealed for generations.
In the small courtyard, the power of rebellion is quietly dormant, waiting for the arena to open, to break all laws in one battle, and to reveal the eternal truth in one battle.
